# BIDS validation fixtures

Real datasets in the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS), for `test/bids-validator-integration.test.ts`.
Nothing here is generated by the tests, and no validator output is stored: the tests run the vendored validator on these files and read what it says.

## bids-minimal

A copy of `test/fixtures/bids-minimal` in nemarOrg/nemar-cli, which `nemar admin e2e-test` uploads.
Byte for byte the same as nemar-cli `dev` at `54ae05ef` (last changed there in `5759b908`, 2026-02-24).
One subject with one electroencephalography (EEG) recording (a European Data Format (EDF) file), its sidecars, and `participants.tsv`.
The validator reports no errors and a few dozen warnings on it.

## annex-pointer

`participants.tsv` from `bids-minimal`, as git-annex stores it for an unlocked file: a pointer to the content, not the content.
Made with git-annex 10.20261006 by `git annex add participants.tsv` with `annex.addunlocked` set, then `git cat-file -p HEAD:participants.tsv`.
The key is the real size and SHA-256 of the file it stands for, and `git annex calckey` gives the same one.
Put it in place of the real file and the validator reports errors on it.
The repository check ignores errors on such files, and `src/lib/bids-validation/gate.ts` does the same.

## hed

Two files that overlay `bids-minimal` to make it a Hierarchical Event Descriptors (HED) dataset.
`dataset_description.json` names HED 8.3.0, a schema the validator ships.
`sub-01_task-rest_events.tsv` annotates its two events with tags from that schema, and `sub-01_task-rest_events-invalid.tsv` has the same events with one tag that is not in it.
They are here to run the validator's HED module, which is most of the bundle, offline.
